svg.text: Every line between blocks is a real call, labelled with what it carries. HTTP paths omit the /api/v1 prefix; {t} = community, {id} = ride, {s} = seat.

SECURITY on every request · CORS → JWT bearer (auth.py, HS256) → member / admin check → community scoping (other communities = 404) → pydantic validation · bcrypt passwords · sign-in rate limit
